metric_definitions.junction_pixels: 8-neighbour degree >=3 foreground pixels, not CN graph nodes
metric_definitions.cn_clusters: production crossing number: 8-connected endpoint CN=1 or junction CN>=3 clusters
metric_definitions.branch: 8-connected component after removing degree>=3 foreground pixels; legacy diagnostic, not a traced stroke
metric_definitions.raster_proxy: gray<210 then skimage skeletonize, without Stage 1 cleanup
metric_definitions.matched_frame: binary ink area resampling to longside 1024, threshold >=0.5, then skeletonize; resampling may change topology
metric_definitions.stage1_input: oracle reference-free degraded raster; no OCR approximation
metric_definitions.acceptance: historic numeric bands are provisional; no synthetic deployment-gate calibration
